title: Cream Cheese Swirl Brownies
changes_from_base: Unsweetened chocolate batter marbled with a soured cream and cream cheese swirl; kept chilled.
summary: Unsweetened chocolate brownies marbled with a soured cream and cream cheese swirl.
equipment: 20 cm square metal baking tin, lined with baking paper
heatproof bowl and small pan (or a microwave)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Swirl
steps.text: Soften the cream cheese for 20-30 s in the microwave, then whisk in the soured cream, sugar and the tablespoon of flour until smooth.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Heat the oven to 160 °C (140 °C fan) and line the tin. Mix the flour, baking powder and salt in a small bowl.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Melt the chocolate and butter together, whisk in the sugar, then the eggs and vanilla, and finally stir in the flour mixture.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Spread half the batter in the tin, dot over half the cream cheese mix, cover with the rest of the batter and dollop the remaining cream cheese on top. Drag a knife through in loops to marble.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 35-40 min, until the edges are firm and a skewer pushed into a brownie part shows a few moist crumbs.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool in the tin for 1 h, then chill 1 h for clean cuts. Cut into 16 and keep in the fridge.

tips: Dot the cream cheese mixture over the batter and drag a knife through just a few times, so the swirl stays bold instead of blending in.
Soften the cream cheese so the swirl is smooth.
Test doneness in a brownie area, not the cream cheese.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 4 days.
